q: The Lorenz system ẋ = σ(y−x), ẏ = x(ρ−z)−y, ż = xy−βz has a strange attractor for σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3. The attractor is:
opts: A fractal set with sensitive dependence
exp: The Lorenz attractor is a strange attractor: a fractal invariant set on which dynamics are chaotic (sensitive dependence on initial conditions). It was the first rigorously studied strange attractor.
